title: Key pass interference decision in Rams-Broncos looked like the right call

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Key pass interference decision in Rams-Broncos looked like the right call
sources.description: Sunday night's instant classic between the Rams and Broncos had a back-to-the-future moment, when teams coached by Sean McVay and Sean Payton were involved in a potential pass interference situation with the game on the line.
